name: Bar 45
description: Bar 45 Restaurant and Bar is a local hangout for great food, cold drinks, and a laid-back vibe located at ONE Club. Whether winding down after golf, catching up with friends, or watching the game, it offers classic favorites and tasty bar bites, cold drafts, creative cocktails, and wine. The venue features happy hour specials and weekly entertainment.
